source.title: Densities and derived thermophysical properties of the 0.9505 CO2 + 0.0495 H2S mixture from 273 K to 353 K and pressures up to 41 MPa

productionDecision.rationale: The complete contiguous 273 K homogeneous-gas block has 19/19 convergence, 0.616767% AARD and 1.595572% worst deviation. No composition or state interpolation is claimed.
